shared_elements: human figure with head, torso and limbs
elongated object held/extended from the figure (staff or weapon-like item)
figure occupying the upper portion of the field
justification: Both show a single human figure with an extended linear object (a staff/spear in A, a rod-like item in B), which is a generic correspondence at best. A is a detailed naturalistic profile bust with elaborately curled hair and beard above two carefully modelled horned rams shown in profile, while B is a bare stick-like frontal figure with no animals and no interior detail, so subject matter, relationships and drawing conventions diverge almost entirely.
